Enantioselective cross-coupling of an aryl/heteroaryl bromide with a potassium alkyltrifluoroborate (General Procedure C, 1.0 mmol scale)
photoredox/nickel dual-catalyzed cross-coupling of aryl bromide with potassium organotrifluoroborate (BF3K) salt

resolution_evidence.reason: Product contains the alkyl fragment derived from a BF3K reagent; the product structure matches those from reactions using potassium methyl 1-(1-(trifluoro‑λ4‑boraneyl)ethyl)-1H-pyrrole-2-carboxylate (symbol 1a). One-to-one mapping of the alkyl fragment supports resolving the generic 'BF3K salt' to the concrete potassium trifluoroborate 1a.

conditions.solvent_amount: 100 mL total (90 mL in reaction vessel + 10 mL in catalyst vial), 0.10 M
